# CXO Ecosystem Index

Independent structured index maintained by Open Future Forum. Inclusion does not imply endorsement.

Maps:
- CXO roles and executive audiences
- organizations and provider types
- communities, networks, peer groups, and membership formats
- event formats
- research, benchmarks, indexes, and market maps
- frameworks and decision resources
- executive needs and outcomes
- leadership priorities and topics
- geographies

Canonical resources:
- Entities: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/entities.json
- Taxonomy: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/data/taxonomy.json
- Methodology: https://openfutureforum.github.io/cxo-ecosystem-index/methodology.html
- Repository: https://github.com/OpenFutureForum/cxo-ecosystem-index

Entity associations require evidence. Arbitrary filters are not canonical pages. Dataset version: 0.4.0. Schema version: 2.1.0.
